rules.title: No bare except, keep the cause
rules.body: Never write except: or except Exception: pass. Catch the specific exceptions you can handle; when you raise a new one, chain it with raise NewError(...) from e.

rules.title: Type hints on new functions
rules.body: New and changed functions have type hints for parameters and return values, in the style the module already uses. Optional values are checked for None before use.

rules.title: No mutable default arguments
rules.body: Never use a list, dict or set literal as a default argument value; use None and create the value inside the function.

rules.title: Parameters, never string-built SQL or shell
rules.body: Pass values to SQL as query parameters, never with f-strings, % or + into the query text. Run subprocesses with a list of arguments, never shell=True with values from outside.

rules.title: Context managers for resources
rules.body: Files, database connections, locks and HTTP sessions are opened with with statements so they are closed on every path. Outgoing HTTP calls set a timeout.

rules.title: Decimal for money, aware datetimes
rules.body: Money and other exact amounts use decimal.Decimal (or integer minor units), never float. Datetimes are timezone-aware (UTC inside the system).
